title: microprobe-harvest-stencil-2029-10-18
body:
Purpose:
This is a compact harvest of recent microprobes (2-week window) across mid-market and enterprise customers focused on inference cost, KV cache behavior, routing fallbacks, and Private deployment onboarding friction. The note collects raw asks, quick impact sketches, and low-effort probes we can run in the next sprint.

Context / quick snapshot:
- Window: 2029-10-01 — 2029-10-15
- Sources: CS triage threads, solutions eng intake, two post-demo interviews, payment dispute logs (anonymized)
- Customers represented: 3 AI-native startups (PLG), 4 mid-market product teams, 2 enterprise POCs (finance + healthcare)
- Top emergent themes: predictable token costing for streaming, kv-cache invalidation clarity, private onboarding network checklist, graceful model downgrade semantics when Dedicated pools saturate.

Top asks (clustered, with short customer phrases):
1) Streaming cost preview and invoice delta safeguards
   - "We want to know expected token burn before streaming starts; our UX can't surprise billing."
   - Impact: reduces customer support churn for unexpected invoices; medium revenue protection.

2) KV-cache visibility and TTL controls
   - "Our assistant's memory seems sticky after prompt edits — hard to reason about costs and correctness."
   - Ask: add per-route cache TTLs and cache-hit analytics in Console.

3) Soft-fallback logging + fidelity tags for model downgrade
   - "When Redwood downgrades to a cheaper variant, we need a signal to the app (and human ops) that output might differ."
   - Proposal: lightweight header or webhook and rollout label.

4) Private onboarding network checklist (preflight)
   - "We wasted two days debugging egress rules and DNS for the control plane — checklist would cut that in half."
   - Proposed artifact: one-page checklist + Terraform snippets.

5) Tokenization mismatches across model variants
   - "We saw different token counts when switching quantized variants — affects cost forecasting and rate limits."

6) Predictable batch sizing guidance for bursty workloads
   - "Our traffic is spike-y; we need recommended autoscale/burst settings that don't blow the budget."

7) Function-calling error surface reduction
   - "Function calls sometimes return partial JSON — can we add stronger schema validation or clearer error codes?"

8) More granular per-route cost attribution in SDK logs
   - "We need per-feature cost attribution for internal chargeback (not just per-token global)."

Customer quotes + short provenance (for follow-up):
- "Streaming surprise hit us by 30% on last month" — PLG startup (onboarded May 2029), source: billing dispute CS-1129.
- "KV feels stale after rapid prompt edits" — e-comm mid-market, demo notes 2029-10-03.
- "Private install took two engineers 3 days; checklist would have saved time" — healthcare POC, solutions eng call 2029-10-09.

Quick impact sketch and estimated effort (Rough):
- Streaming cost preview UI + API header: Low effort (1 sprint frontend + 0.5 sprint backend) -> High customer goodwill, reduces billing disputes
- KV-cache TTL and visibility: Medium (2-3 sprints infra + Console) -> Medium revenue/prod quality impact
- Fallback signal (header/webhook): Low (1 sprint infra) -> High reliability signal for customers; low risk
- Private onboarding checklist: Very low (docs + terraform snippets) -> Immediate ROI for onboarding pipeline

Low-effort probes (can ship within 2 weeks):
- Add a "Preview token estimate" dev-only endpoint for streaming requests (beta flag) — aim: reduce surprise invoices
- Console: add a small badge on routes showing "cache-hit rate last 24h" (pulled from existing metrics)
- Docs: publish a one-page Private preflight checklist + annotated firewall/TCP list (solutions eng + release engineering pair)
- Infra: emit a short header X-Redwood-Fallback: variant=redwood-mini;confidence=low on downgraded responses

Safety/edge risk notes (quick):
- Preview token estimator needs clear disclamers; tokenization variance across quantized models can cause mismatches. Add a margin (e.g., +15%) default.
- Fallback header could be abused by downstream systems for gating; keep labeled as advisory not authoritative for final billing decisions.

Open questions / unresolved:
- Do we want the preview-estimator to account for downstream function-calls which may inflate token usage? (Score: medium priority to decide)
- Should per-route cost attribution be surfaced in Console first, or be an SDK-level export? (Ops vs. Dev tradeoff).
- Which security review path for header/webhook changes for Private deployments? (Need SRE + Security signoff)

Prioritization recommendation (CS lens):
- Sprint A (next 2 weeks): shipping docs checklist, fallback header, streaming-preview beta endpoint
- Sprint B (next 6 weeks): cache-visibility MVP + metrics, add Console badge and route-level analytics
- Backlog (next quarter): per-route cost attribution export, TTL controls with enforcement

Owner matrix (short):
- Streaming-preview beta endpoint -> Owner: Ethan Kline (eng-serve-runtime) + Nora (CS) for beta calls
- Fallback header -> Owner: Platform engineering (Luis Ortega) + Security review (Priya Raman)
- Private preflight checklist -> Owner: Solutions eng (Maya Chen) + Release engineering
- Cache visibility badge -> Owner: Observability (Maya Chen) + Console PM (TBD)

Notes to self / quick log:
- Cross-check token estimator against model variants list in catalog; flag quantized profiles where tokenizing differences are >10%.
- Add one sample Terraform snippet for GCP VPC-SC egress and an example DNS override used in the healthcare POC.
- Triage JIRA CS-1129 for billing followup; ask Billing Ops for anonymized bill snippet.

Immediate next steps (this week):
1) Ping Platform engineering to scope fallback header -> @Luis in Slack (thread linked).
2) Draft Private preflight checklist in docs repo; loop in Solutions eng for verification.
3) Create a small beta flag for preview estimator and invite 3 customers to opt-in for Nov pilot.

Appendix: short list of linked threads we should surface in the follow-up doc (internal):
- Slack thread: #cs-inference-feedback (2029-10-05 -> 2029-10-12)
- JIRA: CS-1129 (billing dispute)
- Confluence: PROBES-2984 (previous probe summary, 2029-08)

Draft endline (for later packaging):
- Convert this harvest into a 1-pager for PM sync; include 3 sample bill snippets (redacted), 1 preflight checklist, and the fallback header RFC.

-- Nora (notes, working draft)
